prompt: Create an original 90 second pastoral acoustic instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: concert harp, flute, viola. Style: rolling harp figures and long woodwind answers. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective classical piece featuring strings, piano, and woodwinds. It has a gentle, flowing melody with a somewhat somber yet beautiful atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而沉思的古典乐曲，以弦乐、钢琴和木管乐器为主。旋律轻柔流畅，营造出一种略带悲伤但优美的氛围。
